""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str, max_functions: Optional[int] = 35) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ if not html_content or not isinstance(html_content, str): return [] # Return an empty list if input is invalid or empty soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen_names = set() # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (Sphinx-style docs) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen_names: seen_names.add(name) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Extract return type if present return_type = "unknown" sig_return = block.find(class_="sig-return") if sig_return: return_type = sig_return.get_text(strip=True) else: # Fallback to infer return type from signature match = re.search(r"->\s*([\w\[\], ]+)", signature) if match: return_type = match.group(1).strip() # Find description in next dd element dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") description = "" params_info = {} if dd: # Get main description from first paragraph first_p = dd.find("p") if first_p: description = first_p.get_text(strip=True) else: description = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:300] # Extract parameter descriptions from dl/dt/dd structure param_list = dd.find("dl", class_="field-list") if param_list: for param_dt in param_list.find_all("dt"): param_name = param_dt.get_text(strip=True) param_dd = param_dt.find_next_sibling("dd") if param_dd: params_info[param_name] = param_dd.get_text(strip=True)[:150] if not description: description = "No description found" functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature, params_info), "return_type": return_type, }) # Extract functions from headers functions += extract_from_headers(soup, seen_names) # Extract functions from code blocks functions += extract_from_code_blocks(soup, seen_names) return functions[:max_functions] if max_functions else functions def extract_parameters(signature: str, param_descriptions: Dict[str, str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("return_type") and doc["return_type"] != "unknown": output.append(f"Returns: {doc['return_type']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: param_line = f" - {param['name']}" if param.get('type') and param['type'] != 'unknown': param_line += f" ({param['type']})" if param.get('description'): param_line += f": {param['description']}" output.append(param_line) output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
